source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of biogeochemical cycles (PDF 230).

blocks.text: Biogeochemical cycles kimiyai anasir, jaise carbon, nitrogen, oxygen aur phosphorus, ki ecosystem ke zinda (biotic) aur be-jaan (abiotic) hisson ke darmiyan chakkar dar harkat hain.

blocks.prompt: Biogeochemical cycles mein chalne wale do anasir batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, phosphorus (sulfur aur calcium bhi).

items: Biogeochemical cycles anasir ko ecosystems ke zinda aur be-jaan hisson ke darmiyan chalate hain.
